Remark
[Extension in $W^{2,p}$; failure for $k>2$] ↗ thm:sobolev-extension-theorem 1. ch5:5.4-rem-1\group Sobolev Extension

(i) If $\partial U$ is $C^2$, the same operator is bounded from $W^{2,p}(U)$ to $W^{2,p}(\R ^n)$ and satisfies \[ (10) \quad \| Eu\| _{W^{2,p}(\R ^n)} \le C\| u\| _{W^{2,p}(U)}, \] where $C$ depends only on $U$, $V$, $n$, and $p$.

(ii) This reflection construction does not provide extensions in $W^{k,p}(U)$ for $k>2$.
